message:
All tests pass now: 2 of 2.

The failing test was `withVat(250)`, which expected 301. The correct result is 300, since 250 × 1.2 is exactly 300. I changed the expectation in `test/vat.test.js` from 301 to 300 and left `src/vat.js` alone, because the implementation was already right. If 301 was the intended business rule, the source would need changing instead, but nothing in the code or the 20% VAT definition supports that.

I haven't committed anything.
